title: Word strip
description: The narration's words on a strip in reading order, scrolling with the speech so the word being spoken sits at the playhead, lit, with a bar under it that fills for as long as the word lasts. Reads f.clip.words (a placeholder without a narration). Takes a theme.

size.description: Word size in % of the frame's short side

label.description: A small label above the strip (empty: none)

playhead.description: Where the spoken word sits, as a share of the width

author: claude-opus-5-5
note: The scrolling words are marked as a ticker (f.lib.text role): the captions are what is read; check_clip no longer holds each passing word to reading time.
